newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 6.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
- Bill Clinton won a second full term as president of the United States by a solid margin in the country's voting polls.
- A strong economy helped Clinton convince voters to give him a second term in office.
- Clinton won the country's presidential election with a smaller and less clear political manifesto.
- More than half of the voters who came out of the polling stations were having second thoughts about the ballots they had cast.
- Russian doctors described as a success the heart operation they did on President Boris Yeltsin.
